sentences.text: This is an appeal under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (for short 'L.A.Act') filed by the acquiring body against the judgment and award dated 10.01.2012 passed in Land Acquisition Case No.129/2005 by the learned 2nd Joint Civil Judge, Senior Division, Wardha (hereinafter referred to as 'Reference Court') by which the compensation is enhanced in favour of the respondent/claimant.

3. Respondent No. 1's land admeasuring 0 H 30 R out of Survey No.20/2 admeasuring 1 H 62 R situated at mouja Wagda, Taluka Arvi, District Wardha was acquired for the Left Bank Canal of Upper Wardha Project.
Special Land Acquisition Officer (for short 'SLAO') granted rate of Rs.47,000/- (Rs. Forty Seven Thousand) per hectare for the acquired land.
Being not satisfied with the rate granted by the SLAO, respondent No.1 filed the above reference application for enhancement of a compensation.
The claimant led his evidence.

The learned Reference Court passed the impugned judgment and award enhancing the compensation at the rate of Rs.2,00,000/- (Rs.
Two Lakhs) per hectare on the basis of the judgment dated 21.10.2011 in L.A.C. No.127/2004.
4.
There is no dispute in respect of the purpose for which the land of respondent No.1 was acquired and the extent of respondent No.1's land for the same.

The SLAO granted compensation @
Rs.47,000/- (Rs. Forty Seven Thousand) per hectare.
The impugned judgment shows that the learned Reference Court enhanced the compensation on the basis of the above referred judgment dated 21.10.2011 in the above reference.
The said judgment which formed the basis to enhance the compensation, arose out of the same award dated 10.09.2001 passed by the SLAO.
There is nothing on record to show that the said judgment and award in L.A.C. No.127/2004 was upset before the Higher Forum.
This being the undisputed aspect of the matter, no fault can be found with the enhanced compensation awarded by the learned Reference Court.

5. Further, the record indicate that the pursis dated 08.01.2020 was filed by the appellant Acquiring Body contending that, the enhancement in the amount of compensation was less than four times than the rate granted by the Land Acquisition Officer and was covered by the Government Resolution dated 23.02.2017 and 13.02.2018 and the Department wants to withdraw the appeal.

6. Considering all these aspects of the matter, the following order is passed :
i] First Appeal is dismissed with no order as to costs.
ii] Record and proceedings be sent back to the learned Reference Court.
iii] Award be drawn up accordingly.
(NEERAJ P. DHOTE J.) RGurnule Signed by: Mrs. R.M. MANDADE Designation: PA To Honourable Judge Date: 06/01/2026 18:50:08
